Chahar to Ramesh Mendis, 1 run 
there's the win, Sri Lanka's second ODI win in 2019! And it's come off a neatly hit sweep 
to deep square. Three-wicket win that lifts them off the bottom of the ODI Super 
League points table India take the series 2-1. 
Sri Lanka will be mighty pleased with the way their batters approached the chase 
upfront. Avishka Fernando nearly batted through, and his partnership with their other 
half-centurion Bhanuka Rajapaksa helped wipe out a good chunk of the target. With the 
ball, there were wickets for Akila Dananjaya and Praveen Jayawickrama, both of whom 
picked up three apiece. 
11.30pm It appeared as it the chase will be a cakewalk for Sri Lanka, but the Indians 
kept coming back at them. Rahul Chahar was particularly impressive, picking up three 
wickets, but India just didn't have enough runs on the board. From 147 for 3, they 
collapsed to 225. And that is perhaps where they lost the match. 
The presentation is coming up shortly. 
Avishka Fernando is the Player of the Match. "If we had done well in the second match, 
we would have won the series," he says. "I am very happy for the Player-of-the-Match 
award today though. After the England tour, I worked on my batting and that has helped. 
We have a very young side and going forward I believe we will do well." 
Dasun Shanaka: Congratulation to India for the series win. It was a very good series 
throughout. Young guys showed a lot of maturity, both with bat and ball and that's what 
I expect from them. It's a big win for fans, they were waiting for years for this win; we 
have won against India at home after quite some time. 
Suryakumar Yadav is the Player of the Series. "I think I have been doing the same thing 
for last two years," he says. "I wanted to score big in the last two games but... The 
atmosphere in the camp is really positive. Really looking forwards to the T20I series." 
Shikhar Dhawan: Things didn't go our way after rain break. We had a good start but lost 
too many wickets in the middle. Think we were 50 runs short. I am glad that they made 
their debut because everyone has been in the quarantine for a long time. So we had that 
opportunity today having sealed the series. I always analyse where I can improve and 
get better. We were positive about defending the target but at the same time we knew 
we were 50 runs short. I am happy of the way the boys fought. 
Dhawan picks up the trophy and poses for the camera. Then he joins his team-mates 
and hand over the trophy to Sakariya, Chahar and Gowtham. All smiles. 
That's all from our side for tonight. See you soon.
